description: This file defines the SerialPortException class used in the jSSC library for handling serial port communication errors. It provides constants for various error types and methods to retrieve exception details.

classes.name: SerialPortException
classes.description: Custom exception class for serial port errors, including error type constants and contextual information about the port and method where the exception occurred.

methods.name: SerialPortException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with port name, method name, and exception type.

methods.name: getPortName
methods.description: Returns the name of the serial port associated with the exception.

methods.name: getMethodName
methods.description: Returns the name of the method where the exception was thrown.

methods.name: getExceptionType
methods.description: Returns the specific type of the exception.
